summary: Mostly no. On 1h, price after UO(7,14,28) went below 30 or crossed up through 30 or 35 did no better than after a random candle. The result that holds up is on 4h: after UO was below 30, price was 3.7% ahead of random entries 20 candles later, and the gap held without its strongest episode.

verdicts.text: On 4h, price after UO below 30 ran 3.7% ahead of random entries 20 candles later, and the gap held without its strongest episode. On 1h it sat inside the luck band, and daily has too few moves to judge.

verdicts.use: Buying the cross up through 30 or 35
verdicts.text: On 4h the cross up through 30 beat random entries only because of one signal on Nov 4, 2020. On 1h, and for the 35 cross on every timeframe, it landed inside the luck band.
On 1h, price kept rising after readings above 70, and the short did 0.47% worse than random after 20 candles. On 4h the cross down through 70 did 1.22% worse, and on daily both sat inside the band.
Worse than random entries on 4h, and the result holds without its strongest stretch. On 1h and daily it sat inside the luck band.

notes: On 4h, UO(7,14,28) below 30 gave 92 entries in 56 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 3.7% ahead of random entries, above a luck band that topped out at 2.36%. The gap holds without its strongest episode and also shows at 10 candles, but not at 50 or 100. BTC, ETH and SOL each have too few moves to judge alone, so the result rests on the three pairs pooled.

On 1h the same condition gave 899 entries, against 92 on 4h, and landed 0.36% behind random entries, inside the luck band. On BTC 1h it looked worse than random, but only because of 19 entries on Jun 12–14, 2022, during the Celsius withdrawal freeze. Without them, chance.

Crossing up through 30 on 4h beat random entries by 2.68%, but the whole gap comes from one signal on Nov 4, 2020. Without it, chance. On 1h the cross up through 35 fires about four times as often as the cross up through 30, and neither left the luck band. The 35 cross showed nothing on 4h or daily either.

Shorting while UO was above 70 on 1h did 0.47% worse than random entries after 20 candles. It holds without its strongest stretch, Jan 2–3, 2021, and shows at 10 and 100 candles, though not at 50. On 4h the cross down through 70 did 1.22% worse and holds without its strongest stretch. The level above 70 on 4h looked bad only because of signals on Jan 2–4, 2021.

Going long on a cross up through 50 on 4h did 0.23% worse than random entries. It holds without the stretch between May 5, 2021 and May 23, 2021, and shows again at 50 candles. On 1h and daily the same cross sits inside the luck band.

For a long DCA bot on 4h, UO below 30 is a condition to test as a filter beside your other start conditions. The move it shows fades by 50 candles, so it fits a take profit that fills within about 10 to 20 candles better than a long hold. On 1h it adds nothing the DCA orders and take profit don't already do. For a short bot, readings above 70 on 1h and crosses down through 70 on 4h are a reason to leave the condition out, because price kept rising after them.
